:::{#exr-sxy-expand}
#### Expanding the centered sum of cross-products

Expand the centered sum of cross-products $\sspredout$ (@def-centered-cross-product)
into an expression in terms of $n$, $\sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs$, $\predbar$ and $\outbar$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-sxy-expand}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sspredout
&= \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)
&& \text{(definition of $\sspredout$)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{\predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \outbar \predvar_\iobs - \predbar \outvar_\iobs + \predbar \outbar}
&& \text{(expand the product)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \outbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs - \predbar \sumin \outvar_\iobs + \sumin \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(distribute the sum, constants factor out)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \outbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs - \predbar \sumin \outvar_\iobs + n \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \outbar \cdot n \predbar - \predbar \cdot n \outbar + n \predbar \outbar
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \predbar$, $\sumin \outvar_\iobs = n \outbar$)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \predbar \outbar - n \predbar \outbar + n \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(collect the $n \predbar \outbar$ terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
